oracle_revision: V2 original failure preserved; lower-panel origins moved outside authored surface, four exact reviewed bracket-partial occlusions measured separately, ground-facing z0 contact classified explicitly. V4 adds12 camera visibility rays to each normal-blocked sample and independently proven local FLOAT32 boundary exception.
scope: Static authored buffer and original material verification. No final visual, native, browser, codec, source-owner, collision or navigation acceptance.

material_source_proof.generation_scope: Pure generate_fields plus in-memory PNG encode; no output files or author file writes.

textures.uv_scope: Actual triangle Jacobians; repeat is unbounded. No [0,1] UV restriction. Runtime derivative normal signs remain separate browser checks.

exterior_rays.scope: Exterior front arch/closed-door setback, all 336 authored front grid-cell centres, ten actual timber stiles/lower panels, three side/rear infill rays. Window probes start0.080m ahead of pavilion facade, outside the0.056m leaf bead and0.035m lower solid panel, inside foreground parapet: local aperture geometry, not street visibility. Four specified upper cell centres may intersect reviewed curved eave arms only if real glazing exists behind and an alternate same-aperture ray is unobstructed. Glazing recession uses glazing hits only. These sample actual triangles; they do not prove watertightness, interiors or walk-through access.

coplanar_overlap.scope: All active triangles queried through three dominant-axis projection trees, without rounded plane bins; candidates rechecked at <=2e-5m plane distance, 1e-8 normal dot tolerance and >1e-6m2 overlap. One interior point per positive-area intersection has an outward normal ray up to100m. Clear outward ray confirms exposed duplicate above the virtual ground. Strict downward z0 contacts are counted separately because the declared flat scene ground covers them; no positive-height face gets that exemption. Normal-blocked samples are additionally tested toward 12 explicit exterior ground/overview cameras; a clear front-facing sightline fails. Remaining blocked samples are not a global internalness proof. One reviewed platform shared-edge FLOAT32 residue may be classified only after actual all-triangle source matching and bounded width proof. Opposite-facing overlaps are possible component contacts, not a solid-volume/internalness proof. No exhaustive near-coplanar/slanted visibility guarantee.

local_numeric_boundary_proof.exception_scope: Only the reviewed upward platform/wall-walk shared edge; exact pre-quantization source intersection has zero area. No general area tolerance increase, no hidden-surface exemption.
